caption: The drawing depicts a wooden sled with metal runners and a child’s sleigh. The sled is oriented at an angle, with the front curved runners facing toward the left side of the image. The structure consists of a rectangular box-like seat with high curved sides and is painted in shades of brown and blue, visible wood grain texture and metallic rivets. The seat is mounted on red-painted wooden runners, which extend forward and backward, with additional curved metal supports underneath for stability. There is a greenish-yellow and blue strap or harness lying on the left side of the sled, positioned over the runners. The background is a plain, lightly textured beige, and the objects cast soft shadows on the surface beneath them. The drawing is rendered with clear outlines and subtle shading, emphasizing the shapes and dimensionality of the objects.
title: Toy Sleigh
